verdict.rationale: Linear's 'Loops' feature explicitly lets users describe a job in plain language and have Linear Agent run it autonomously on a schedule or in response to an event, covering recurring background automation like doc updates and status maintenance, and separately agents can autonomously investigate/fix issues before reaching an engineer. This is well documented across multiple changelog entries with concrete examples (docs updates, incident investigation, SLA monitoring). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor docs, and more detail on reliability/limits of unattended runs.
